title: OpenAI案例显示AI Agent正进入运营决策与生命科学研发
english: OpenAI News reports three developments across operational automation, investment evaluation, and life-sciences R&D. An independent Schlotzsky’s and Cinnabon franchisee reduced cash reconciliation time by 94% and menu repricing time by 95% using ChatGPT Work, with a workflow that could free up $100K in cash flow. Terminal X says its Eval Agent, using GPT-6.1 Sol and a 54-criterion rubric, matched senior investor judgment 88.6% and caught 25% more mandate deviations. OpenAI is also acquiring Orchestra Bio to bring AI-powered operations to biopharma R&D and help accelerate drug development.
chinese: 三项信息共同指向：AI的落地正在从通用对话扩展到可衡量的业务工作流。餐饮加盟商案例聚焦对账、菜单定价和现金流；Terminal X案例聚焦以明确评估标准辅助投资判断；Orchestra Bio收购则将AI运营能力带入生物医药研发场景。现有材料仅说明相关机构披露的结果与目标，未提供具体技术架构、部署方式或验证方法。
why_it_matters: 对云原生与AIOps团队而言，这些案例强调了Agent Infra的关键要求：把模型输出接入可审计的业务流程，并用明确的评估标准衡量偏差、效率和业务结果。职业发展上，资深运维开发需要能够设计评估链路、工作流编排、权限边界与可观测性，而不只负责模型调用。
interview_expression: I focus on turning AI outputs into auditable operational workflows. For agent systems, I would define explicit evaluation criteria and monitor deviations against the intended business policy.

vocabulary.meaning: 对账；核对账目或记录以确认一致性
vocabulary.example: The team reduced reconciliation time by automating routine checks.
The Eval Agent uses a rubric with 54 criteria.

vocabulary.meaning: 偏差；偏离既定标准或要求的情况
vocabulary.example: The system identifies deviations from the fund's mandate.
